description: Covers events in Türkiye (Turkey) only. Searches current listings on biseyvarmi.com, which gathers events across Turkish ticket providers: what is on, where and when (etkinlik, ne var, konser, tiyatro, stand-up, sergi, festival, çocuk, opera, bale, atölye), in a city or district such as İstanbul, Kadıköy, Beşiktaş, Ankara or İzmir, with dates, venues and prices. Requires at least one of city, category or q. Each result includes its biseyvarmi.com event page link (a short bise.ws link), where dates, prices and ticket options are confirmed. At most 20 results, no paging; a district, category, dates or words give more specific results. A refused question returns the reason.

city.description: A Turkish city by name, e.g. "istanbul", "ankara", "izmir", "mugla"; a well-known district ("bodrum", "kadikoy") also works.

district.description: A district of the city, e.g. "kadikoy"; needs city.

from.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD (Istanbul time). Default today.

q.description: Search words in Turkish or English: a title, performer or venue. Alternatives are separated by commas (at most four).

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default from + 30 days; a wider span is cut to 92 days.

name: search_events
title: Search events in Türkiye
